panels.art: Wide shot at the foot of the Wall of Letters: Dan at the left and the child-sized Silent at the center stand together, while Mira at the right has stopped three steps away, out of breath, her red cord on her left wrist. Behind them the wall's top gap still pulses faintly vermilion.

lines.ru: Стена за спиной всё ещё шепчет голосом Дэна. Мира пришла на этот голос — и остановилась в трёх шагах от маленькой Безмолвной.

lines.en: You find her.
lines.ru: Ты нашёл её.
lines.delivery: low quiet relief, gruff and halting, almost smiling

lines.en: She finds me.
lines.ru: Это она меня нашла.
lines.delivery: gentle simple reply, a warm half smile, steady

panels.art: Quiet two-shot at the wall's foot: Mira at the right looks at the ground and rubs the back of her neck, awkward and stiff. Dan at the left raises one finger like an engineer with an idea. A little ochre lantern glows between them.

lines.en: I am sorry, Zero.
lines.ru: Прости, Зеро.
lines.delivery: quiet awkward apology, rubbing her neck, stiff and sincere, unused to saying sorry

lines.en: I don't like your plan. But I have a new plan. We make a sentence for the last door.
lines.ru: Мне не нравится твой план. Но у меня есть новый план. Мы составим предложение для последней двери.
lines.delivery: calm kind firm voice, honest and forgiving, practical hope

panels.art: Tense shot: Mira at the left clenches her red cord in her fist and leans forward as if to step, but her feet stay rooted. The child-sized Silent in the center turns its blank face toward her, arms hanging. The System window floats at the right.

lines.ru: Мира не может подойти. Проданное слово оставляет Дыру: её ноги сами обходят всё, что это слово называло.

lines.en: Mira holds her cord. She does not hold the child.
lines.ru: Мира держит свой шнурок. Ребёнка она не держит.
lines.delivery: cool flat system observation, quiet and sad, precise

lines.en: I can't. I don't know why.
lines.ru: Я не могу. Я не знаю почему.
lines.delivery: low trembling voice, ashamed and confused, struggling with her own body

panels.art: Tense shot in a narrow stone corridor: a huge black iron-banded door fills the center and right of the frame. Dan at the left presses both palms flat against it, shoulders straining, small vermilion sparks around his hands, but the door does not move. Mira stands behind with her arms crossed; the System window floats top right.

lines.en: This door is strong. PUSH is weak here.
lines.ru: Эта дверь сильная. PUSH здесь слабое.
lines.delivery: flat dry system warning, plain and grave

lines.en: I can say OPEN. It does nothing. The Keeper has it.
lines.ru: Я могу сказать OPEN. Оно ничего не делает. Оно у Хранителя.
lines.delivery: tired and practical, a rueful voice, stating the problem

panels.art: Quiet close shot: Dan alone at the center rests one hand on the cold iron door and studies the joints of the stones around it with an engineer's squint; faint ochre construction-style lines seem to trace the seams of the wall as he thinks. His yellow pencil is behind his right ear.

lines.ru: Слово — это камень. Но стену держат не камни, а кладка. Инженер в Дэне наконец поднимает голову.

lines.en: One stone is not a wall. The Tower makes a sentence. I can make a sentence too.
lines.ru: Один камень — ещё не стена. Башня делает предложение. Я тоже могу сделать предложение.
lines.delivery: slow thoughtful inner voice, a spark of an idea building, calm and warm

panels.art: Two-shot in the corridor: Dan at the left gestures with an open hand, drawing three small invisible points in the air with a fingertip, explaining. Mira at the right has her arms crossed and one eyebrow with the scar raised, sceptical.

lines.en: We buy words. They don't make a sentence. Nobody can.
lines.ru: Мы покупаем слова. Они не делают предложение. Никто не может.
lines.delivery: flat tired fact, bleak and dry, years of failed hope in the voice

lines.en: I learn words. Who? I. What do I do? Open. What? The door.
lines.ru: Я учу слова. Кто? Я. Что делаю? Открываю. Что? Дверь.
lines.delivery: quick excited counting, bright and clear, building a sentence word by word

panels.art: Bright overexposed shot: Dan alone at the center stands calm with his hand extended toward the iron door. From his mouth a steady horizontal row of four glowing vermilion glyph shapes travels in a neat straight line, like a sentence on a ruled page. At the far side the great iron door swings quietly inward and white light spills out.

lines.en: I open the door.
lines.ru: Я открываю дверь.
lines.delivery: calm confident clear voice, steady and strong, saying the sentence like a spell

lines.en: Sentence: 4 words. True. One breath.
lines.ru: Предложение: 4 слова. Правда. Одно дыхание.
lines.delivery: crisp flat system announcement, a faint ring of wonder

panels.art: Two-shot: Mira at the right stares at the now-open iron door, mouth open, stunned. Dan at the left gives a modest shrug, smug and tired at the same time. The System window floats above the center. Beyond the open door is a dim passage with a distant ochre light.

lines.en: One breath? For that door? You have no OPEN!
lines.ru: Одно дыхание? За эту дверь? У тебя нет OPEN!
lines.delivery: stunned breathless voice, wide eyed disbelief, almost angry at the miracle

lines.en: I don't need a strong word. Every door hears a true sentence.
lines.ru: Мне не нужно сильное слово. Любая дверь слышит правдивое предложение.
lines.delivery: calm easy modest voice, warm with a small grin, explaining like a teacher

lines.en: A true sentence makes small words yours. DOOR is yours now. Count: six.
lines.ru: Правдивое предложение делает маленькие слова твоими. DOOR теперь твоё. Счёт: шесть.
lines.delivery: crisp flat system announcement, precise, a ceremonial pride

panels.art: Playful montage in one frame: Dan at the left laughs, holding a small lit oil lamp in his raised right hand and a brass key in his left, while small vermilion glyph shapes orbit him like fireflies. The iron door stands half-closed behind him. Mira at the right has her arms folded and one eyebrow raised, almost smiling. The System window hovers at the top.

lines.en: I close the door. I hold the lamp. I find the key. I see the stone. I touch the stone!
lines.ru: Я закрываю дверь. Я держу лампу. Я нахожу ключ. Я вижу камень. Я трогаю камень!
lines.delivery: playful rapid joyful voice, laughing, bubbling with delight, listing actions like a game

lines.en: A true sentence is strong. Count: 14.
lines.ru: Правдивое предложение сильное. Счёт: 14.
lines.delivery: flat crisp system count, impressed, slightly smug

lines.en: Stop. You play.
lines.ru: Хватит. Ты играешь.
lines.delivery: dry amused voice, half scolding, with a smile creeping in

panels.art: Warm comic shot: Mira at the right faces the iron door with one hand raised, mouth open mid-word, a neat row of four steady vermilion glyph shapes leaving her lips, and the door slides closed softly. Her mouth curls into a tiny first smile. Dan at the left grins, one finger raised like a teacher.

lines.en: I... close... door.
lines.ru: Я... закрыть... дверь.
lines.delivery: slow clumsy and serious, a beginner struggling, comic effort with long pauses

lines.en: Not true. That is not a sentence.
lines.ru: Неправда. Это не предложение.
lines.delivery: flat dry system judgment, deadpan

lines.en: The small words are free. Say 'the'. Say it with me.
lines.ru: Маленькие слова бесплатны. Скажи «the». Скажи вместе со мной.
lines.delivery: patient friendly teacher voice, warm and encouraging, a little laugh

lines.en: I close the door.
lines.ru: Я закрываю дверь.
lines.delivery: careful proud voice, slow and clear, a small shy smile

panels.art: Wide low-angle shot of the bare stone last hall: broken lamps are scattered and unlit on the floor, a high black wooden door with iron bands at the far end. The Keeper stands upright in the center, not in a chair, hands folded, hood hiding his eyes. At the right a tall Silent with two round dents on its blank face and a strip of mustard-yellow lanyard at its neck heads a silent line of tall Silents along the wall. Dan at the left, small, has stopped in the doorway.

lines.ru: Лампы в последнем зале сметены. Хранитель стоит — впервые не в кресле. За ним неподвижной шеренгой стоят Безмолвные.

lines.en: I am Dan.
lines.ru: Я Дэн.
lines.delivery: hollow smooth monotone, flat and eerie, stolen name in a dead voice

lines.en: Welcome to the last hall. A new sentence, Zero! Every jar in my hall hears it.
lines.ru: Добро пожаловать в последний зал. Новое предложение, Зеро! Каждая банка в моём зале его слышит.
lines.delivery: calm velvety unsettling voice, slow and warm, a gentleman gloating politely

panels.art: Tense two-shot in the hall: Dan at the left and the Keeper at the right face each other two paces apart. The Keeper holds out his open palm toward Dan, asking for his name; Dan's jaw is set, his fists closed, shaking his head. Tall Silents wait in shadow behind the Keeper.

lines.en: Forty years, and nobody makes a new sentence here. I need one more word. Your name. Give it to me.
lines.ru: Сорок лет никто здесь не составлял новых предложений. Мне нужно ещё одно слово. Твоё имя. Отдай его мне.
lines.delivery: soft smooth courteous voice, patient and cold, quietly greedy, each phrase polished

lines.en: No trade. I don't fight. I make sentences.
lines.ru: Никакой сделки. Я не дерусь. Я составляю предложения.
lines.delivery: firm calm voice, quiet defiance, steady and brave

lines.en: Then no trade. They take it.
lines.ru: Тогда без сделки. Они его заберут.
lines.delivery: cold gentle voice, silky, final, with a faint smile

panels.art: Action shot in the hall: Dan at the left thrusts his hand forward, vermilion abstract glyph shapes streaming from his mouth to freeze the nearest tall Silent at the right, which stops mid-step with a vermilion rim. Mira at the center-left has both hands braced against the iron door behind them, holding it shut. More tall Silents advance in shadow behind.

lines.en: I stop the Silent! I close the way!
lines.ru: Я останавливаю Безмолвного! Я закрываю путь!
lines.delivery: fierce determined shout, commanding, power in every word

lines.en: Don't fight them all! Hold the door!
lines.ru: Не дерись со всеми! Держи дверь!
lines.delivery: sharp urgent shout, fierce and decisive, giving orders in a battle

panels.art: Powerful action shot: Mira at the center throws her head back in a full-throat shout, vermilion light pouring from her mouth and her red cord blazing, rings of abstract vermilion light spreading across the hall as the tall Silents in front stagger back with their arms raised. Dan at the left shields his face. The tall dented Silent with the yellow lanyard strip at the right still walks on toward Dan.

lines.en: I am Dan. I am Dan.
lines.ru: Я Дэн. Я Дэн.
lines.delivery: hollow smooth chorus, eerie and flat, a dead voice repeating itself

lines.en: Stop! Every one of you!
lines.ru: Стойте! Все до одного!
lines.delivery: full throated roaring shout, raw and ragged, spending her last breath

lines.en: Mira fights with her last breath.
lines.ru: Мира дерётся последним дыханием.
lines.delivery: grave soft system voice, slow and heavy, quietly mournful

panels.art: Low tense shot: Mira lies on the stone floor, pale, eyes closed, her red cord dull on her left wrist. A tall plain Silent (no dents, no lanyard, a different one from the dented Silent) bends over her, its seam close to her face. The Keeper stands behind at the right; the System window floats above in warning style, solid vermilion frame.

lines.en: I am Mira.
lines.ru: Я Мира.
lines.delivery: hollow breathy whisper, flat dead voice, uttering her stolen name

lines.en: Word lost: MIRA.
lines.ru: Слово потеряно: MIRA.
lines.delivery: cold quiet system notice, final and gentle, a heavy silence after

lines.en: Not the name I want. But a name is a name.
lines.ru: Не то имя, которое мне нужно. Но имя есть имя.
lines.delivery: silky regretful voice, calm and polite, shrugging with mild satisfaction

panels.art: Dark shot: Mira at the left kneels with one hand at her throat, mouth open in a silent gasp, eyes wide and frightened. The Keeper at the center-right is half-lit, holding a tiny glass jar with one vermilion spark in his open palm. The System window at the right edge has a solid vermilion frame. Everything else is black; Dan's silhouette stands frozen at the far left edge.

lines.en: I am... I am...
lines.delivery: broken gasping whisper, terrified and lost, voice fading mid word

lines.en: Mira? Mira?
lines.ru: Мира? Мира?
lines.delivery: thin hollow child-like voice, soft and puzzled, repeating a name

lines.en: Bring your name to my hall, Dan. Then she has hers.
lines.ru: Принеси своё имя в мой зал, Дэн. И тогда у неё будет её имя.
lines.delivery: calm velvety unsettling voice, soft and slow, an elegant threat with a smile

lines.en: Mira is Zero now.
lines.ru: Мира теперь Зеро.
lines.delivery: quiet flat system voice, final and heavy, a slow chill

grammarNote.title: Порядок слов: кто + делает + что
grammarNote.body: В английском предложении порядок почти всегда один: сначала тот, кто действует (I), потом глагол (open), потом то, с чем он действует (the door): I open the door. Нельзя выбросить маленькие слова: «I close door» — это ещё не предложение, поэтому у Миры сначала ничего не получилось. Слово the стоит прямо перед существительным и тоже является частью порядка. В Башне такое предложение, если оно правдивое, стоит одно дыхание и делает слова твоими.

quiz.q: Почему PUSH не открыл железную дверь?
options: Дверь была слишком сильной для одного слова
Мира держала её с другой стороны

quiz.q: Сколько дыханий стоило первое предложение Дэна?
Почему у Миры сначала не получилось?
options: Она сказала без маленьких слов, и это не предложение

quiz.q: Чьё имя забрал Безмолвный в конце серии?
